clues.clue: Cohort born between 1965 and 1980, for short
clues.definition: Gen X, short for Generation X, is the demographic cohort commonly defined as people born from 1965 through 1980.
clues.explanation: GENX fits because the clue gives the standard birth-year range for Generation X and signals the compact four-letter form with “for short.”
clues.signal: The date range identifies a named generation, while “for short” requires its abbreviated crossword form.
clues.hint: Combine the common three-letter shortening of “generation” with the cohort's identifying letter.

clues.definition: In tic-tac-toe, a player wins by placing three matching marks in a horizontal, vertical, or diagonal line.
clues.explanation: XXX fits because three X marks in a row form one possible winning line; the entry represents the marks themselves rather than naming the game.
clues.signal: “Line” is literal here: the answer visually shows the three identical marks that can win the game.
clues.hint: Write the same mark three times—the mark used by the player who moves first in the usual version of the game.

clues.clue: One-named Senegalese American singer with the #1 hits "I Wanna Love You" and "Don't Matter"
clues.definition: Akon is a Senegalese American singer and producer known for 2000s hits including “I Wanna Love You” and “Don't Matter.”
clues.explanation: AKON fits because both quoted Billboard Hot 100 hits were recorded by the four-letter mononymous singer described in the clue.

clues.hint: Think of the four-letter stage name of the artist who also recorded “Lonely” and “Smack That.”

clues.clue: Summer meteor shower named for a mythological hero
clues.definition: The Perseids are an annual meteor shower whose apparent radiant lies in the constellation Perseus, named for the Greek mythological hero.
clues.explanation: PERSEIDS fits because this prominent summer meteor shower appears to radiate from Perseus, directly connecting the astronomical event to the hero named in the clue.
clues.signal: The season, astronomical category, and mythological naming clue point to a specific annual shower rather than a constellation alone.
clues.hint: Use the eight-letter plural name of the August shower associated with the constellation named after Medusa's slayer.

clues.definition: A Panama hat is a lightweight, broad-brimmed hat traditionally woven from toquilla straw in Ecuador.
clues.explanation: PANAMAHAT fits the description of a broad-brimmed straw topper; the two-word name is entered without a space in the nine-letter grid answer.
clues.signal: “Topper” means a hat, while “broad-brimmed” and “made of straw” narrow the style to a familiar two-word name.
clues.hint: Name the nine-letter hat style famously associated with a Central American country, although it is traditionally made in Ecuador.

clues.clue: Puzzle solver's breakthrough, or what the answers to the starred clues have in common
clues.definition: An aha moment is a sudden realization in which a previously unclear idea or solution becomes understandable.
clues.explanation: AHAMOMENT fits the first definition as a solver's sudden breakthrough and also names the theme: each starred answer contains the adjacent sound pattern “A-HA.”
clues.signal: The phrase after “or” announces a revealer: the answer must both define a breakthrough and explain a repeated feature in starred entries.
clues.hint: Think of a nine-letter phrase for the instant when the solution suddenly clicks; enter it without a space.

clues.definition: Yoshi is a dinosaur-like Nintendo character who debuted as Mario's companion in the 1990 video game “Super Mario World.”
clues.explanation: YOSHI fits because the five-letter Nintendo character was introduced in the game named directly in the clue and is commonly described as Mario's dinosaur companion.

clues.definition: Achoo is an imitation of the sound of a sneeze.
clues.explanation: ACHOO fits because “Gesundheit” is conventionally said after someone sneezes, and the five-letter entry spells the sound of that sneeze.
